jobs.title: Sr Manager, Transformation
jobs.description:
Company Description:

McDonald’s is proud to be one of the most recognized brands in the world, with restaurants in over 100 countries that serve 70 million customers daily. We continue to operate from a position of strength. Our updated growth strategy is focused on staying ahead of what our customers want and realizing further growth potential. Our relentless ambition is why McDonald’s remains one of the world’s leading corporations after almost 70 years. Joining McDonald's means thinking big and preparing for a career that can have influence around the world.

At McDonald’s, we see every day as a chance to create positive impact. We lead through our values centered on inclusivity, service, integrity, community and family. From support of Ronald McDonald House to our Youth Opportunity project and sustainability initiatives, our values keep us dedicated to using our scale for good: good for our customers, people, industry and planet. We also offer a broad range of outstanding benefits including a sabbatical program, tuition assistance and flexible work arrangements.
Department Overview

McDonald's is evolving its global marketing model to be more connected, efficient, and effective. As part of this effort, McDonald's is establishing a Future of Marketing team to define how marketing capabilities, processes, and ways of working will evolve over time. The team will help the business better leverage scale, improve consistency across markets, and strengthen the overall effectiveness of marketing investments.

Reporting to the Customer Engagement Tower Lead, the Future of Marketing: PSD – Customer Engagement: Owned Strategy (CRM) will support the design of future-state process workflows, RACI frameworks, and operating models for how McDonald's manages owned channel strategies and CRM capabilities across global and market teams.

The role requires solid knowledge of CRM, owned channel strategy, and customer lifecycle marketing, along with the ability to contribute to process design and documentation that enables consistent, scalable owned engagement across a complex, multi-market QSR environment.

Duties

- Support the design of end-to-end process workflows to deliver cohesive and integrated experiences across loyalty, owned experiences like app, kiosk and menu boards as well as CRM, including campaign planning, audience management, and lifecycle communications.

- Contribute to the development of RACI frameworks that define roles and decision rights across global, market, and technology teams for owned channels execution.

- Document current-state process gaps and inefficiencies and contribute to future-state solutions that improve consistency and speed.

- Partner with CRM, Loyalty, Martech, and Data to design f uture-state CRM process workflows that provide the foundation for scalable personalization and LTV optimization, in close partnership with Data, Insights, and Audience Strategy teams.

- Partner with CRM, Loyalty, Martech, and Data teams to ensure CRM process designs determine necessary technical capabilities and data availability to deliver owned experiences.

- Collaborate with the Global CRM and Martech teams to assess and determine requirements for best-in-class tools and systems

- Assist in developing governance standards for owned channel activation, including approval workflows and content governance.

- Collaborate with the Customer Engagement Tower Lead and PSD leads to ensure CRM process design is integrated with broader campaign and consumer experiences development processes.

- Support the development of process documentation and stakeholder communication materials.

Qualifications

- Solid experience in CRM, owned channel marketing, or customer lifecycle strategy within a marketing organization.

- Understanding of how owned channel processes & Audience strategy processes operate across global and market teams in a multi-market environment.

- Experience contributing to process design, documentation, or operating model work in a cross-functional setting.

- Familiarity with CRM and Loyalty platforms, marketing automation tools, and data-driven personalization approaches.

- Collaboration & Influence: Influences without direct authority; unites matrixed stakeholders around common goals.

- Navigating Ambiguity: Brings structure to the undefined; creates actionable frameworks from complex issues.

- Communication: Articulates complex strategies and "the why" to mid-to-senior level stakeholders.

- Prioritization & Workload: Prioritizes competing projects; balances immediate team workloads while keeping focus on strategic goals.

- Execution & Leadership: Strategic problem-solver; connects operational process to broader business outcomes

Compensation

Bonus Eligible:  Yes

Long - Term Incentive:  Yes

Benefits Eligible: Yes

Salary Range

The expected salary range for this role is $141,955.00 - $177,444.00 per year

The above represents the expected salary range for this job requisition. Ultimately, in determining your pay, we may also consider your experience, and other job-related factors.

Additional Information:

Benefits eligible: This position offers health and welfare benefits, including but not limited to comprehensive health insurance, which includes medical, prescription drug, mental health, dental and vision coverage, as well as, life insurance.

Bonus eligible: This position is eligible for a bonus, calculated based on individual and company performance.

Long term Incentive eligible: This position is eligible for stock or other equity grants pursuant to McDonald’s long-term incentive plan.

If you need assistance accessing or reading this job posting or otherwise feel you need an accommodation during the application or hiring process, please contact mcdhrbenefits@us.mcd.com. Reasonable accommodations will be determined on a case-by-case basis.

jobs.title: Manager, Finance Business Partner
jobs.description:
Company Description:

At McDonald's, we are committed to being the best, and that starts with finding the best people. We have built a team of extraordinary people from around the world. We are problem solvers, risk takers, innovators, and thought leaders that take our work seriously, but have fun doing it. We challenge ourselves to get smarter and sharper every day, we value personal and professional growth, and believe in rewarding and celebrating our successes.
The Opportunity

Reporting to the Senior Manager, FP&A and Business Partnering, this role will be a key member of the Finance team and a trusted strategic partner to the Marketing organization. The Manager, Finance Business Partner (Marketing) will provide financial leadership and guidance to the Marketing Leadership Team and oversee the financial management of the National Marketing Forum (NMF) and Regional Marketing Forums (RMFs), ensuring sound financial stewardship, governance, and risk management.

The successful candidate will be responsible for overseeing the accounting activities of the NMF and RMFs through an external accounting partner, leading quarterly forecasting and financial planning processes, and coordinating the preparation and reporting of financial statements to lending institutions. The role also includes providing regular financial insights and recommendations to the Boards of Directors and Operator Leadership bodies.

Beyond the core responsibilities, this position offers the opportunity to serve as a Finance thought partner on national cross-functional initiatives and strategic projects, influencing key business decisions that support the growth and success of the McDonald's Canada system.

Key stakeholders include the CMO, the Marketing Leadership Team, Boards of Directors, financial institutions, external accounting partners, auditors, the CFO, and Operator Leadership teams.

Who you are

You are a proven financial leader who will be a key member of the Marketing and finance functions. You will support various levels of leadership, provide counsel and report to guide business decisions to move the team forward and make an impact on strategic initiatives. You have strong communication skills to effectively support the team in a fast paced and agile environment.

What’s in it for you?

This is an unparalleled opportunity to join a winning organization during an exciting time of transformational and accelerate growth. You will gain exposure across all levels of the organization, from your team members to the Executives and Franchisees. You are looking for a company with a winning culture where you can grow in depth and breadth while making a tangible impact on central initiatives.

Duties

In addition to following McDonald’s policies and procedures, principal accountabilities include, but are not limited to:

Strategic/Business Development

- Active member of the Marketing Leadership team in the development of short and long-term strategies

- Finance Lead within Marketing and for cross functional initiatives that impact the Marketing Forums

- Strategic business partnering with various stakeholders to optimize costs and maximize returns while supporting business priorities

- Oversight of risk management for Marketing Forums

- Engage and lead discussions with Marketing Forum Board of Directors on finance related matters and strengthen confidence in management of Marketing Forums financials

- Provide key strategic and financial oversight on cross function teams for special projects

Fiduciary Responsibility

- Overseeing the finances for the Marketing Forums which include compliance with accounting and reporting standards, maintaining financial controls and safeguarding the assets of the Marketing Forums

- Ensuring the financial health of the Marketing Forums including cash flow management

- Management of the Audit for the National and Regional Marketing Forum of Ontario

- Responsible for presenting the audited financial statements at the Annual General Meetings (“AGM”)

- Enhancing processes and ensuring adherences to guidelines and funding principles related to overall governance of the Marketing Forums

- Working with Stakeholders to develop the Annual Budget and providing projections to Marketing Leadership including Board of Directors

- Foster a culture of accountability with stakeholders as it relates to budget and expenditure management

People

- Foster an environment that supports and develops a high-performing team

- Responsible for educating stakeholders on understanding financial information, policies, procedures and governance

- Identifying and implementing process improvements to enable development of the team

- Manages key relationships with banks, suppliers and accounting firms to support the ongoing success of the Marketing Forums

Qualifications

- Bachelor’s degree in related discipline with a CPA designation required.

- A minimum 5-7 years of relevant business experience.

- Dynamic interpersonal skills to develop strong relationships with key stakeholders and be an effective and strategic business partner

- Thrives in a dynamic and ever-changing environment, with the ability to adapt and shift priorities as required

- Excellent written and verbal communication and presentation skills.

- Solid influencing and strategic leadership skills.

Salary Range

The expected salary range for this role is $89,599.00 - $127,998.00 per year

The above represents the expected salary range for this job requisition. Ultimately, in determining your pay, we may also consider your experience, and other job-related factors. This is an existing position.

Additional Information:

McDonald’s Canada and Owner/Operators are committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace for all. Our workplaces have a long-standing policy of providing fair, equitable, and accessible opportunities for all employees and prospective employees. Accommodations during the application process are available upon request.
We do not use artificial intelligence (AI) or automated tools to screen, assess, or select applicants during our recruitment process

jobs.title: Manager, Financial Planning & Analysis
jobs.description:
McDonald's is veel meer dan restaurants alleen. Achter iedere nieuwe productlancering, prijsstrategie, marketingcampagne en operationele verbetering zit een organisatie die continu kijkt hoe het morgen nog beter kan. Als Manager Financial Planning & Analysis sta jij midden in die dynamiek. Je vertaalt data naar inzichten, inzichten naar keuzes en keuzes naar resultaat. Daarmee ben je een belangrijke sparringpartner voor de CFO, het Leadership Team en collega's door de hele organisatie.

In deze rol werk je nauw samen met de CFO, het Leadership Team, Global Finance en collega's uit Marketing, Supply Chain, Technology en Operations. Ook vertegenwoordig je de Nederlandse markt binnen de Revenue Growth Management agenda en ben je lokaal verantwoordelijk voor pricing.
RUNNING GREAT RESTAURANTS BY GREAT PEOPLE

Wij staan voor oprechte aandacht voor onze gasten, persoonlijke ontwikkeling, innovatie en duurzame groei. Vanuit Finance draag jij hier direct aan bij. Als strategische sparringpartner voor de CFO ondersteun je de business met financiële inzichten die richting geven aan de toekomst van de organisatie.

INGREDIËNTEN VAN DEZE JOB

De rol van Manager FP&A is een McFlurry aan verantwoordelijkheden:

- Je bent verantwoordelijk voor marktprognoses, scenarioanalyses en financiële projecties.

- Leidinggeven aan een klein team van financiële professionals hoort ook bij de rol, net als bijdragen aan hun ontwikkeling.

- Je beheert de financiële planning- en forecastcyclus en zorgt voor kwalitatieve en tijdige input voor besluitvorming.

- Samen met de CFO stel je marktplannen op, bespreek je de belangrijkste keuzes en zorg je voor afronding.

- Je werkt nauw samen met het BI-team en geeft feedback om tijdige, inzichtelijke rapportages, dashboards en analyses over omzet, gasten en marketingprestaties te realiseren.

- Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de prijsstrategie, prijsanalyses en samenwerkingen met leveranciers. Ondersteunt datagedreven prijsbeslissingen die een goede balans creëren tussen groei, gastwaarde en rendement voor franchisenemers.

- Je leidt de financiële rapportage en vertaalt resultaten naar heldere inzichten en concrete acties voor Quarterly Business Reviews (QBR's) en Market Reviews. Maakt complexe prestaties begrijpelijk en ondersteunt besluitvorming met sterke storytelling.

- Je ondersteunt de ontwikkeling en beoordeling van business cases voor marktinitiatieven.

- In samenwerking met Finance en Financial Control werk je aan financiële rapportages, reviews en analyses.

- Business reviews, leadership meetings en andere strategische overlegmomenten ondersteun je met heldere financiële inzichten.

- Daarnaast voer je ad-hoc analyses uit en ondersteun je de organisatie bij complexe financiële vraagstukken.

DOORGROEIMOGELIJKHEDEN

Deze rol is stevig verankerd in Nederland, maar speelt zich af binnen een internationale omgeving met veel contact met Segment en Global Finance. Bij McDonald's is persoonlijke ontwikkeling belangrijk. Heb jij de ambitie en het potentieel om verder te groeien, dan zijn er volop mogelijkheden binnen Finance, richting een bredere leiderschapsrol binnen de business of binnen een internationale context.

Met jouw bijdrage creëer je nieuwe kansen voor de organisatie, maar ook voor jezelf. Je maakt onderdeel uit van het Finance team van ruim 20 collega's en werkt dagelijks dicht op de business, de CFO en het Leadership Team.

JOUW MENU

Wij zoeken een collega die energie krijgt van impact maken. Iemand die met scherpe analyses, heldere inzichten en duidelijke keuzes de business écht verder helpt. Je schakelt moeiteloos tussen detail en strategie, tussen lokaal en global en tussen Finance en de rest van de organisatie.

Je staat stevig in je advies, maar weet mensen mee te nemen met een open, verbindende stijl. Met energie, humor en een goed gevoel voor storytelling vertaal jij cijfers naar keuzes die richting geven. Analytisch sterk, business-minded en comfortabel in stakeholdermanagement: dat is wat jij meebrengt.

- Academisch werk- en denkniveau, bij voorkeur in Finance, Business, Economie, Econometrie of een vergelijkbare richting.

- Minimaal 5 tot 7 jaar relevante werkervaring binnen Finance, FP&A of vergelijkbare financiële functies.

- Minimaal 3 jaar ervaring met het aansturen, coachen en ontwikkelen van een team.

- Sterk begrip van P&L dynamiek, forecasting, planning, business cases en performance management.

- Ervaring met data, reporting en analytics tools; je weet het verschil tussen rapporteren en echt inzicht geven.

- Sterke communicatieve vaardigheden en ervaring met het presenteren aan senior stakeholders.

- Ervaring met pricing, Revenue Growth Management, retail, QSR, FMCG of franchiseorganisaties is een pre.

- Goede beheersing van de Nederlandse en Engelse taal.

ONS MENU

- Een jaarcontract voor 40 uur per week

- De mogelijkheid jouw werkzaamheden gedeeltelijk vanuit huis te verrichten in combinatie met een goed thuiswerkbeleid (inrichting werkplek thuis en thuiswerkvergoeding)

- Volop ruimte voor persoonlijke groei en ontwikkelingsmogelijkheden

- 30 vakantiedagen plus een jaarlijkse persoonlijke verlofdag, die je helemaal naar eigen wens kunt gebruiken.

- Een moderne mobiliteitsregeling waaronder een NS-business card om van en naar kantoor te reizen

- Een aantrekkelijke bonusregeling

- Premievrij pensioen

- Een iPhone en laptop om je werkzaamheden uit te voeren

- Een prachtig kantoor direct naast Utrecht Centraal met heerlijke koffie en vers fruit

Daarnaast bieden wij een salarisrange van  € 6.371,00  tot  € 7.964,00   bruto per maand  (exclusief 8% vakantiegeld). De uiteindelijke inschaling is afhankelijk van de kennis en ervaring die je meebrengt.

ONZE WAARDEN

Bij McDonald's zien we elke dag als een kans om een positieve impact te creëren. We leiden door onze waarden: Servicegericht, Inclusiviteit, Integriteit, Goede Buur en Partners.

Van het ondersteunen van de Ronald McDonald Huizen tot onze duurzaamheidsinitiatieven: onze waarden helpen ons om onze schaalgrootte op een positieve manier in te zetten.

jobs.title: Commercial Finance Manager
jobs.description:
McDonald’s Australia is the largest quick service restaurant operation in the country. Fondly known as “Macca's”, we have been a household name in Australia for over 50 years, we believe that our customers are the heart and soul of everything we do and make it our mission to make every moment count! As an employer of choice winner time and time again, working with us means taking pride and having fun along the way; while growing and developing your career in a dynamic and supportive environment.
Could you be our next Commercial Finance Manager?

Are you ready to bring your commercial acumen to the heart of one of Australia's most recognised businesses? We have an exciting opportunity for a Commercial Finance Manager to join our Finance team. Reporting to the Sr Manager, Field Finance, this is a key operational leadership role delivering financial strategy, insights and support across restaurant operations in multiple regions. You'll partner closely with internal stakeholders, banking partners and franchisees to drive financial integrity, operational efficiency and alignment with our broader business strategy with a real focus on enabling data-driven commercial decisions and growing franchisee financial health.

What you can expect on a day-to-day basis:

- Leading the regional finance function, setting and executing financial goals aligned to broader business objectives

- Assessing the financial health of potential operators to inform franchising decisions, and managing financial onboarding, due diligence and compliance

- Representing commercial priorities within state representative committees

- Driving initiatives to improve profitability and the financial health of licensees across your regions

- Setting restaurant economics to deliver profitable, sustainable portfolio outcomes

- Delivering performance analysis, insights and reporting that inform commercial decisions

- Providing day-to-day financial advice and support to franchisees, resolving queries with pace and professionalism

- Contributing to margin improvement, cost optimisation and capital allocation strategies

- Preparing Performance Decks for Quarterly Business Meetings and supporting the Finance and Supply Chain Committee

- Championing financial systems and integrations to lift reporting, forecasting and efficiency

- Coaching and developing junior team members, fostering accountability and continuous improvement

Your keys to success:

- Experience leading small teams, with a passion for developing othersStrong commercial acumen and a track record of business partnering across finance and operational functions

- Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills - you can turn financial data into insight people act on

- Solid financial modelling and analytical skills, with strong attention to detail

- Proven ability to develop and influence strategic initiatives and outcomes

- CPA or CA qualified (or working towards), with 3+ years' experience in commercial or field finance roles preferred

Relish in the Macca's difference when you join the Golden Arches:

- Competitive Remuneration Package.  We offer a total reward package of base salary, health care,   long-term incentive share program and a target incentive bonus plan.

- 5 Weeks of Annual Leave.  Switch off and recharge or explore your passions outside of work with an additional week of annual leave each calendar year.

- Flexible Work Environment.  Our teams have embraced a hybrid working model, balancing working remotely and connecting in the office to support our people and how they best add value.

- Paid Parental Leave.  We proudly support growing families with paid parental leave top-up options, helping you take the time you need while maintaining financial stability.

- Birthday & Volunteer Leave.  Enjoy a day-off during your birthday month and 3 days annually to volunteer for a registered charity you are passionate about.

- Modern Office with Sustainable Amenities.  Newly revamped office located in Thornleigh featuring the latest technology and electric car chargers to support eco-friendly commuting.

- Ongoing Professional Development.   We are committed to developing our people by investing in leadership programs and free access to LinkedIn Learning.

- Macca’s Staff Discount & Retail Discounts.  Enjoy discounted Macca’s at any restaurant across Australia and access to hundreds of retail discounts.

- Access To Our 24/7 Wellbeing Partner (Sonder) For You & Your Immediate Family.  Using the Sonder app, access free and confidential safety, medical and mental health support via chat or phone with accredited professionals.

- A Fun & Vibrant Culture.  Immerse yourself in local and Macca’s only events and experiences from day one of working with us.

At Macca’s, our doors are open to everyone, and we live by our Golden Rule: treating everyone with dignity, fairness and respect, always. We’re committed to building a safe, inclusive and welcoming workplace where everyone feels valued and empowered - it’s our people who make us Macca’s.

As an equal opportunity employer, we strongly encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, identities and experiences. If you have a disability, illness or injury and need adjustments during the recruitment process, we’re here to help, just reach out to start the conversation.

jobs.title: Manager, Data Governance
jobs.description:
About McDonald’s:

One of the world’s largest employers with locations in more than 100 countries, McDonald’s Corporation has corporate opportunities in Hyderabad. Our global offices serve as dynamic innovation and operations hubs, designed to expand McDonald's global talent base and in-house expertise. Our new office in Hyderabad will bring together knowledge across business, technology, analytics, and AI, accelerating our ability to deliver impactful solutions for the business and our customers across the globe.
Department Overview

As a Manager within McDonald's Responsible AI (RAI) team, reporting to the Senior Manager, Responsible AI (AI Risk & Governance), you will serve as a critical bridge between Responsible AI strategy and execution, translating governance requirements into practical processes, platform capabilities, and operational ways of working. The position is responsible for driving day-to-day execution of AI governance initiatives, improving governance workflows, establishing platform integrations, and ensuring AI assets are governed consistently across the enterprise.You will partner closely with Data Governance, Data Science, AI Platform Engineering, Security, Legal, and Business stakeholders to operationalize governance requirements within AI development ecosystems and enterprise governance platforms. Focus will be placed on AI inventory management, model governance, agent governance, platform integrations, and lifecycle management capabilities.This role combines governance platform expertise, technical execution, process optimization, stakeholder management, and business judgment to help scale McDonald's Responsible AI program while enabling innovation across the enterprise.

Duties

Who we’re looking for:

We are seeking an experienced governance and technology leader who can bridge business governance requirements with technical implementation.The ideal candidate combines expertise in governance platforms, metadata management, AI/ML ecosystems, and enterprise operating models. They are equally comfortable discussing governance controls with Legal and Risk teams as they are discussing integrations, metadata, APIs, model registries, and platform architecture with engineering teams.

Primary Responsibilities:

AI Governance Platform Ownership : Own the day-to-day operation and enhancement of McDonald's AI Governance platform capabilities, workflows, and automations, including: AI Use Case Registry, AI Model Inventory, Agentic Inventory and Governance
AI/ML Platform Integration & Connectivity:  Lead technical implementation of integrations between governance platforms and enterprise AI/ML ecosystems, such as Vertex AI
Agentic AI Governance:  Defining governance requirements, inventory processes, and guardrails implementation and reporting for enterprise agentic platform (e.g. Gemini, Copilot, other agent-builder platforms)
Enterprise Cross-functional Risk & Governance Alignment : Partner closely with our key business and technology stakeholders (AI Legal + Security + Data Science + AI Platform Engineering + GCP Platform + others) to align governance processes, controls, and platform capabilities. Click to add description here.

Qualifications

Key Qualifications:

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Data Analytics, or related field.

- 8+ years of experience in  AI governance, model governance, or Responsible AI programs (or related exposure via strong data governance foundations)

- Experience implementing or operating data and AI governance platforms (e.g. Collibra, Informatica) including: platform integrations, APIs, and metadata ingestion solutions

- Strong understanding of enterprise metadata management and inventory management concepts

- Experience working with cloud platforms such as Google Cloud Platform, Azure, or AWS

- Experience working with AI, machine learning, advanced analytics, or data science teams

- Experience designing or improving enterprise governance processes

- Strong analytical, program management, and stakeholder management skillsAbility to work effectively across business, risk, and technical teams

Preferred Qualifications:

- Hands-on experience with Collibra

- Experience with Vertex AI, Databricks, Azure AI, MLflow, or similar AI/ML ecosystems

- Knowledge of AI regulations and frameworks (e.g., EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF, ISO 42001)

- Familiarity with agent-based AI and enterprise AI assistant ecosystems (e.g. Gemini, Copilot)

- Experience working within enterprise risk, governance, compliance, or control environments

- Deep knowledge of software development lifecycle, DevOps, and MLOps concepts

McDonald’s is the world’s leading global foodservice retailer with over 40,000 locations in over 100 countries. Approximately 95% of McDonald’s restaurants worldwide are owned and operated by independent local business owners. At McDonald’s, we lead through our values centered on inclusivity, service, integrity, community, and family. Here is your chance to get in on something special as we grow our corporate team in India and allow you to grow your career.

jobs.title: Manager, HR Systems
jobs.description:
About McDonald’s:

Our global offices serve as dynamic innovation and operations hubs, designed to expand McDonald's global talent base and in-house expertise. Our new office in Hyderabad will bring together knowledge across business, technology, analytics, and AI, accelerating our ability to deliver impactful solutions for the business and our customers across the globe.
SAP SuccessFactors Functional Solutions Consultant (Total Rewards)

We are seeking an experienced SAP SuccessFactors Functional Solutions Consultant to support the Total Rewards (TR) functional vertical within People Experience Functional Solutions Team.

This role will serve as the primary functional partner for Total Rewards processes and SAP SuccessFactors solutions, partnering with People Solutions, Technology, AMS and business stakeholders to drive solution design, platform governance, enhancements, releases and continuous improvement initiatives.

The ideal candidate combines strong SAP SuccessFactors expertise with business process knowledge in Compensation, Variable Pay, Benefits, Workforce Rewards and related HR processes. The role requires a highly consultative individual who can translate business requirements into scalable functional solutions while balancing user experience, governance, data integrity and operational sustainability.

jobs.title: Director, Marketing
jobs.description:
Company Description:

At McDonald's, we are committed to being the best, and that starts with finding the best people. We have built a team of extraordinary people from around the world. We are problem solvers, risk takers, innovators, and thought leaders that take our work seriously, but have fun doing it. We challenge ourselves to get smarter and sharper every day, we value personal and professional growth, and believe in rewarding and celebrating our successes.
The Opportunity

You may have enjoyed some of our work as a fan of McDonald’s. The Grinch Meal that captured the magic of the holidays, the globally celebrated Menu Heist platform that turned menu discovery into a cultural moment, the launch of our breakthrough Red Bull Energizer platform, and maybe even… the next iconic campaign that has the whole country talking.  You may also have thought: wouldn’t it be great to work on campaigns like these that will make you whisper to yourself, “Wow, I did that”? Campaigns that will have your friends and family sending you text messages even though you have not heard from them in a few weeks. “Did you work on that?” Well, this is your chance. Yes, right now. Because we’re looking for a new Marketing Director, Brand & Creative to lead our creative ambition and build iconic campaigns for years to come.

We’re looking for someone who is a McDonald’s fan, thinks like a McDonald’s fan, and acts like a McDonald’s fan. Someone gets the modern customer, not only what they expect from brands but, maybe more importantly, what they do not want from them. The perfect candidate isn’t just familiar with these nuances but is also ready to translate that knowledge into fresh thinking that elevates our creative strategy and pushes the brand towards groundbreaking, culturally inspired ideas.

In this role, you’ll be leading McDonald’s campaigns and creative for Canada, including creative strategies with our agencies to define the right messaging and advertising go-to-market plans. The campaigns span multiple brand stories, such as core food products, value & affordability, and iconic brand moment, balancing between timely and timeless by building McDonald’s fandom in the now and crafting evergreen always-on narratives for the future.

You will be a creative catalyst for tactics that inspire brand love and elevate McDonald’s role in culture. You will also collaborate with cross-functional partners across various teams – Category & Menu Strategy, Customer Engagement, Digital Experiences, Brand Communications, Business Insights, and Consumer Insights to align tactics to marketing and business goals.  That means we are not only looking for a creative crafter but also a business savant who asks “why” before “what.” Lastly, you understand the power of a national approach but are also comfortable with seizing the full firepower of regional work, as you partner with Regional Marketing teams to connect with Canadians coast-to-coast.

Reporting to the CMO, as a the leader of our Brand & Creative team, you will be a critical member of the Marketing Leadership Team, bring an enterprise perspective to the power of creativity, strategic through leadership, and team management to ensure we deliver creative excellence and effectiveness holistically, not just within any individual campaign.

Duties

In this role, you will:

- Ensure the brand vision, strategy and voice are reflected in all marketing efforts related to our key brand stories  to drive the business and elevate the brand in culture.

- Drive brand reappraisal and affinity by working with national agencies to deliver feel good marketing campaigns, befitting of the McDonald’s brand

- Align key stakeholders across the system on campaign ideas, execution and performance/learnings

- Oversee creative agency relationships

- Develop integrated marketing strategies for national campaigns that deliver on McDonald’s and Business Goals

- Partner with Category & Menu Strategy and Strategy & Planning teams to support Marketing calendar development

- Review and approve multiple assets throughout the campaign development such as scripts, casting, translations, POP and creative assets

- Lead teams that handle agency deliverables and timelines in a multi-agency environment

- Lead a team of dynamic and talented creative marketers

Qualifications

- 8+ years experience in Marketing or related field required, either in-house or at an  agency

- Proven experience developing integrated communication strategies and campaigns

- Proven management experience with team of 5+ people

- Strong knowledge of marketing standard methodologies and trends

- Comfortable in a fast-paced, collaborative environment

- Adept at running concurrent projects and priorities

- Proven team leadership skills with project management experience

- Excellent communications and storytelling skills

- Consumer-centric approach

- Ability to identify the need for change and lead teams through it

- Effective ability to balance experience with budget

Salary Range

The expected salary range for this role is $140,000 - $199,000 per year
The above represents the expected salary range for this job requisition. Ultimately, in determining your pay, we may also consider your experience, and other job-related factors.  This is for an exising role.

Additional Information:

McDonald’s Canada and Owner/Operators are committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace for all. Our workplaces have a long-standing policy of providing fair, equitable, and accessible opportunities for all employees and prospective employees. Accommodations during the application process are available upon request.
We do not use artificial intelligence (AI) or automated tools to screen, assess, or select applicants during our recruitment process

jobs.title: Brand Manager (Brand & Social) FTC
jobs.description:
McDonald’s Australia is the largest quick service restaurant operation in the country. Fondly known as “Macca's”, we have been a household name in Australia for over 50 years, we believe that our customers are the heart and soul of everything we do and make it our mission to make every moment count! As an employer of choice winner time and time again, working with us means taking pride and having fun along the way; while growing and developing your career in a dynamic and supportive environment.
Could you be our next Brand Manager (Brand & Social)?

Want your work to be seen, shared and talked about across the country? Excited by the idea of turning cultural moments into campaigns that build real brand love? We're looking for a Brand Manager (Brand & Social) on a 12-month fixed-term contract to join the Brand team in our National Marketing Team. Reporting to the Senior Brand Manager, you'll lead integrated brand, social and creator programs from development through to execution and evaluation. You'll work with best-in-class agency partners, global teams and stakeholders across the business.

What you can expect on a day-to-day basis:

- Leading integrated national brand campaigns from early concept through to launch, optimisation and evaluation

- Briefing and managing creative, production and media agencies, holding partners accountable for quality, timelines and budget

- Building always-on social, creator and cultural programs that keep Macca's authentically part of the conversation

- Managing strategic partnerships and creator activity, from briefing through to performance reporting

- Planning brand experiences and activations that drive engagement and earned media reach

- Working with global teams so local activity matches global brand direction

- Managing marketing budgets and turning campaign results into insights for future planning

Your keys to success:

- Proven experience delivering integrated marketing campaigns in a complex, fast-paced environment

- Hands-on experience across social, influencer/creator marketing, partnerships and activations

- A track record of creating culturally relevant work that resonates with consumers

- Strong commercial acumen and the ability to link data, insights and creative ideas to business outcomes

- Experience managing agencies while keeping relationships strong and productive

- Excellent project management skills, delivering multiple projects on time and on budget

- Clear, confident communication, tailored to different stakeholders

- A tertiary qualification in Marketing, Communications, Business or a related field (preferred)

Relish in the Macca's difference when you join the Golden Arches:

- Flexible Work Environment.  Our teams have embraced a hybrid working model, balancing working remotely and connecting in the office to support our people and how they best add value.

- Birthday & Volunteer Leave.  Enjoy a day-off during your birthday month and 3 days annually to volunteer for a registered charity you are passionate about.

- Modern Office with Sustainable Amenities.  Newly revamped office located in Thornleigh featuring the latest technology and electric car chargers to support eco-friendly commuting.

- Ongoing Professional Development.   We are committed to developing our people by investing in leadership programs and free access to LinkedIn Learning.

- Macca’s Staff Discount & Retail Discounts.  Enjoy discounted Macca’s at any restaurant across Australia and access to hundreds of retail discounts.

- Access To Our 24/7 Wellbeing Partner (Sonder) For You & Your Immediate Family.  Using the Sonder app, access free and confidential safety, medical and mental health support via chat or phone with accredited professionals.

- A Fun & Vibrant Culture.  Immerse yourself in local and Macca’s only events and experiences from day one of working with us.

At Macca’s, our doors are open to everyone, and we live by our Golden Rule: treating everyone with dignity, fairness and respect, always. We’re committed to building a safe, inclusive and welcoming workplace where everyone feels valued and empowered - it’s our people who make us Macca’s.

As an equal opportunity employer, we strongly encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, identities and experiences. If you have a disability, illness or injury and need adjustments during the recruitment process, we’re here to help, just reach out to start the conversation.

jobs.title: Head of Brand, Menu & Communications
jobs.description:
Head of Brand, Menu & Communication

McDonald's Restaurants Belgium HQ · Diegem, Brussels Area

McDonald’s is the largest restaurant chain in the world and also the most people-oriented enterprise around the globe. We are constantly looking for ways to reinvent ourselves in order to serve our customers better, every single day.
The recipe for success is a combination of a strong brand with a lot of freedom for local markets. Rooted in our Belgian society for more than 45 years, we feel particularly committed to our environment and partners. There are currently 131 McDonald’s restaurants in Belgium, run by 26 independent entrepreneurs (Franchisees). Because our business is growing fast-paced, we are looking for talented people to reinforce our head offices that provide support to all restaurants.
Ingredients of this Job

At McDonald's Belgium, we're looking for an experienced marketing leader to drive our brand, menu and communication agenda.

As Head of Brand, Menu & Communication, you will lead the development and execution of our brand strategy, menu innovation roadmap and integrated marketing campaigns. Reporting to the Chief Marketing Officer, you will play a pivotal role in accelerating brand growth, driving guest traffic and ensuring McDonald's remains relevant in a fast-changing consumer landscape.

Your responsibilities

- Define and lead the brand, menu and communication strategy for McDonald's Belgium.

- Translate business objectives into impactful consumer campaigns and growth initiatives.

- Lead the development and execution of the annual marketing plan and campaign calendar.

- Drive menu innovation and portfolio management in partnership with Operations, Supply Chain, Finance and Consumer Insights teams.

- Oversee product launches and ensure compelling communication of menu innovations to consumers.

- Lead relationships with creative, media, production and PR agency partners.

- Manage significant marketing investments and ensure optimal return on investment.

- Represent Belgium in international marketing and menu forums.

- Build strong alignment across internal and external stakeholders.

Team Leadership

You will lead a team of four marketing professionals, including two direct reports and one contractor.

You will be responsible for coaching, developing and inspiring the team while fostering a culture of ownership, collaboration and high performance.

Your Menu

- A proven leader with substantial experience in senior marketing, brand, category or commercial roles.

- A strong track record in brand building, integrated marketing and commercial growth.

- Experience within a food-centered business, with direct responsibility for both product development or portfolio innovation and the communication and commercialization of those innovations to consumers.

- Strong understanding of the connection between consumer insights, product innovation, portfolio strategy and business performance.

- Experience leading cross-functional initiatives involving Marketing, Operations, Supply Chain, Finance and external partners.

- Demonstrated people leadership experience and a passion for developing talent.

- Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills.

- Experience managing agencies and substantial marketing budgets.

- Strategic thinker with a hands-on mindset and excellent execution capabilities.

Why join McDonald's Belgium?

This is a unique opportunity to lead the brand, menu and communication agenda of one of Belgium's largest and most recognized consumer brands. You will combine strategic influence, team leadership and end-to-end responsibility for marketing performance while helping shape the future of McDonald's in Belgium.

What we have to offer you

- Becoming part of an energizing team of the McDonald’s Family;

- Working for an innovative and people-oriented Belgian SME, backed by a strong and leading multinational;

- The freedom to organize your work around your private life;

- A salary package including extralegal advantages like an electric company car and best in class group insurance;

- 30% discount on all McDonald’s products just for you;

- A smile on your face every single working day.

Ready to make an impact? We'd love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Supervisor, Strategic Sourcing Services
jobs.description:
Company Description:

McDonald’s is proud to be one of the most recognized brands in the world, with restaurants in over 100 countries that serve 70 million customers daily. We continue to operate from a position of strength. Our updated growth strategy is focused on staying ahead of what our customers want and realizing further growth potential. Our relentless ambition is why McDonald’s remains one of the world’s leading corporations after almost 70 years. Joining McDonald's means thinking big and preparing for a career that can have influence around the world.

At McDonald’s, we see every day as a chance to create positive impact. We lead through our values centered on inclusivity, service, integrity, community and family. From support of Ronald McDonald House to our Youth Opportunity project and sustainability initiatives, our values keep us dedicated to using our scale for good: good for our customers, people, industry and planet. We also offer a broad range of outstanding benefits including a sabbatical program, tuition assistance and flexible work arrangements.
Department Overview

This position will reside within McDonald’s Global Supply Chain under the Global Strategic Sourcing Services (GSSS) organization. The team is a dynamic, progressive department which contributes directly to the bottom-line performance of the company. Global Supply Chain consults with leaders throughout the company and supports initiatives that are driving McDonald’s into the future.

Duties

The Global Equipment Category Supervisor will be responsible for developing and evolving Category Strategies and Core Suppliers to deliver a resilient and innovative supply chain that assures supply of cost-effective, reliable, and sustainable kitchen equipment. The individual will be accountable for supporting the Equipment Supply Chain Manager in the end-to-end category management of global core equipment, including category strategies, equipment development, equipment performance, aftersales service/support, and supplier management. Additionally, the individual will be responsible in supporting key supply chain initiatives, negotiating pricing and contracts, selecting and qualifying suppliers, risk management, setting product specifications/validation requirements, equipment reliability, sustainability initiatives, data analysis, and communication.

The individual will have ongoing focus on improving the quality of products, services, and performance of the equipment categories they manage while ensuring business requirements are fulfilled and value is optimized.  In addition, this individual will provide support in developing and evolving the Equipment Team’s internal processes to drive efficiencies and structure to category management. The Equipment Supervisor will report to a GSSS Manager, and will work closely with Menu Management, Operations, Innovation, Legal, Supply Chain, Customer Experience, Safety, Marketing, Restaurant Design Group, Markets, Franchisees and Suppliers.

Responsibilities include but not limited to:

- Supporting the Equipment Supply Chain Manager with their assigned equipment categories and suppliers through the following:

- Resolving equipment issues and support needs for various cross-functional projects that support the global or local markets

- Translating industry trends, customer needs and opportunity analysis to design equipment specifications and execute long-term category strategy opportunities

- Completing necessary tasks to gather key supplier data (i.e. volumes, costs, product and service performance statistics, financial information, etc.)

- Identifying supplier risks and formulating suggested mitigation strategies

- Reviewing and approving vendor performance standards and measurements

- Providing input into annual category management strategies

- Facilitating critical issues on behalf of suppliers and internal/external partners

- Project management and execution support of category strategies, from equipment ideation, to testing protocols, to commercialization and deployment

- Independently run assigned categories and supplier relationships

- Negotiation of pricing, service agreements, preventative maintenance programs, warranty, etc. with suppliers

- Ensure stock availability and inventory planning for new product releases and/or special programs

- Understanding of manufacturing and logistics processes

- Management of McDonald’s and Supplier risk and liability, cost mitigation.

- Communication of new product releases as per above negotiations with alignment from stakeholders

- Communicate, evaluate, measure, and implement Supplier Expectations with supplier base

- Serve as an advocate for the Owner / Operator, Company and Supplier by leading successful resolution of field issues and minimizing recurrence through process improvement.

- Executing all necessary communications to ensure accurate and timely flow of information to internal customers, partners, and suppliers

Qualifications

- Critical Competencies and Experiences:

- Experience in effective communication via written and oral methods.

- Strong project management skills and experience in working with cross-functional teams. Multi-market engagement a plus.

- Experience in procurement standard methodologies such as sourcing, RFP processes including supplier negotiations, selection, evaluation, management, and development; must be able to demonstrate “hands-on” experience

- Effectively manages multiple projects and assignments. Product development experience a plus.

- Think critically to structure analyses and processes to solve poorly defined problems

- Negotiate to “grow the pie” and provide mutually helpful contracts and business relationships

- Build positive working relationships both internally and externally to provide McDonald’s with goods and services at the lowest Total Cost of Ownership and lowest risk

- Able to problem solve and search for answers using internal and external network/sources

- Organized and able to effectively handle several responsibilities/projects at once

- Ability to work independently as well as in a cross-functional team setting

- Fosters collaboration and inclusion, highly energetic and team oriented

- Proficient Microsoft Office skills

- People/Relationship Management:

- Able to develop and sustain relationships internally and externally with partners and suppliers, as well as being able to manage up, down and laterally in the organization

- Capable of leading, directing, supporting, and developing others

- Capable of working effectively in multi-disciplinary teams

- Demonstrated ability to self-start, resolving work steps based upon management direction

- Able to align own activities with group’s goals and strategies

- Possess natural curiosity, asking questions when necessary to understand a problem

- Able to lead through influence, establish credibility, and holistically represent the global equipment team to internal and external partners.

- Estimated Travel Up to 15%

Requirements:

- Job Location: Chicago, IL - MHQ

- Bachelor’s Degree required in business, supply chain, finance, engineering, or STEM fields. (Master's degree or MBA a plus)

- A minimum of 4 years’ experience in leading category strategies, supplier relationship management, sourcing initiatives, supply chain management, product development, engineering/purchasing or commensurate experience in related functions

- International experience a plus

- McDonald's experience (operations, finance, business insights, equipment, engineering, supply chain) a plus

- Industry Certifications (e.g. P.E., PMP, CPM, CSCP, etc.) is a plus

Compensation

Bonus Eligible:  No

Long - Term Incentive:  No

Benefits Eligible: Yes

The expected salary range for this role is $78,281.00 - $97,852.00 per year

Department Overview

US Marketing — Marketing & Menu Strategy

The Marketing & Menu Strategy team is responsible for defining and delivering growth for McDonald’s U.S. business by leading strategic planning across marketing levers as well as menu innovation and product development across dayparts and categories.

This role sits at the center of strategy, innovation, and performance for the Breakfast business—one of the most important growth drivers in the U.S. portfolio. The Director will lead both marketing and menu strategy, connecting long-term vision with near-term execution to deliver sustainable growth.

The Role

The Director, US Breakfast Marketing & Menu Strategy is responsible for setting and delivering the strategic vision for the Breakfast daypart. This includes leading 3-year and annual planning, driving business performance, and guiding innovation and commercialization efforts.

This leader will manage a team of three and partner cross-functionally across Strategy & Insights, Culinary, Operations, Supply Chain, and Finance to ensure an integrated and executable plan. The role reports to the Sr. Director, Marketing & Menu Strategy.

Duties

What You’ll Own

Strategic Planning Leadership

3-Year Strategic Planning

- Partner with Strategy Planning and Calendar teams to define the long-term strategic roadmap for the Breakfast daypart.

- Establish a clear innovation cadence (core extensions, LTOs, and new platforms) required to drive sustained growth.

- Define where and how Breakfast should play to win across occasions, audiences, and menu platforms.

Annual Planning

- Lead development of the annual Breakfast plan, including both on- and off-calendar initiatives to deliver business targets.

- Own the Annual Business Review for Breakfast, including:

- Consumer insights and problem definition (in partnership with Audience and Insights teams)

- Identification of key “jobs to be done”

- Alignment on priority initiatives across Marketing, Menu, Audience, and Insights

- Guide initiative development to support business cases and sizing efforts.

- Ensure seamless integration of plans across cross-functional partners.

Breakfast Daypart Business Leadership

- Own the performance of the Breakfast daypart, ensuring delivery against business targets and growth ambitions.

- Partner with Strategy and Insights on in-year performance narratives and drivers of results.

- Lead mitigation planning to address gaps and maximize opportunities.

- Define performance reporting frameworks (monthly, quarterly, annual) to enable strong decision-making and leadership alignment.

Menu Strategy

- Work on product proposition across positioning, pricing, and menu operations to ensure delivery within consumer expectations, on time and within scope.

- Guide the team in product pipeline development, aligning on approach with Insights and other cross-functional partners, as well as external suppliers and operators.

- Ensure internal and external stakeholders are aligned with the product pipeline approach across functions within and outside of Marketing.

Qualifications

Who You Are

Insight-Led Storyteller
You are fluent in both business and consumer data, and you know how to synthesize it into clear, actionable strategies. You don’t just report performance, you define the narrative and identify where to play and how to win.

Strategic Thinker with a Bias for Action
You can zoom out to shape a 3-year vision while also diving in to drive annual plans and in-year performance. You are comfortable navigating ambiguity and turning it into focused, executable plans.

Creative Problem Solver
You balance data with instinct and creativity to unlock breakthrough menu and marketing ideas. You challenge conventional thinking and push beyond incremental solutions to drive step-change growth.

Exceptional Cross-Functional Leader
You build strong partnerships across Marketing, Insights, Culinary, Operations, Supply Chain, and Finance. You know how to align diverse stakeholders, influence without a direct reporting relationship to drive integrated outcomes.

People Leader & Team Builder
You have a proven track record of building and developing high-performing teams. You set a high bar, provide clear direction, and actively coach and develop talent to unlock their full potential.

Innovation Mindset with Operational Discipline
You are energized by building product pipelines and bringing ideas to life—but you also understand the realities of execution at scale. You ensure innovation is both consumer-relevant and operationally viable.

Customer-First Orientation
You consistently anchor decisions in the needs of the customer, ensuring strategies are rooted in real insights and deliver meaningful value across key audiences.

jobs.title: Manager, Strategic Sourcing Services - IT Software
jobs.description:
Company Description:

McDonald’s is proud to be one of the most recognized brands in the world, with restaurants in over 100 countries that serve 70 million customers daily. We continue to operate from a position of strength. Our updated growth strategy is focused on staying ahead of what our customers want and realizing further growth potential. Our relentless ambition is why McDonald’s remains one of the world’s leading corporations after almost 70 years. Joining McDonald's means thinking big and preparing for a career that can have influence around the world.

At McDonald’s, we see every day as a chance to create positive impact. We lead through our values centered on inclusivity, service, integrity, community and family. From support of Ronald McDonald House Charities to our Youth Opportunity project and sustainability initiatives, our values keep us dedicated to using our scale for good: good for our customers, people, industry and planet. We also offer a broad range of outstanding benefits including a sabbatical program, tuition assistance and flexible work arrangements.

Department Overview

McDonald’s has set an ambition to become a Global Indirect Sourcing and Procurement leader. To make this happen, we are standing up a new Global Indirect Sourcing and Procurement Organization (IS&P). This organization will help McDonald’s to better leverage our scale and unlock sustainable value for our company and communities.  We are transforming our Indirect Sourcing and Procurement capabilities, processes, solutions, and ways of working to create One McDonald’s Way of buying Indirect goods and services responsibly.

This role presents an exciting opportunity to help drive this transformation as the Manager, Indirect Strategic Sourcing - IT Software. This key position will be responsible for supporting the development and execution of the IT software category sourcing strategies, ensuring that we maximize McDonald’s value through strategic sourcing and vendor management.

Reporting to the Director, IT Software Sourcing, the Manager will be responsible for executing global sourcing efforts within these categories, working closely with internal stakeholders to understand their needs and deliver value. The  Manager will also contribute to driving continuous innovation and improvements within the sourcing process to support broader business priorities

Duties

- Support Category Strategy Execution: Assist in the execution of sourcing strategies for the IT Software category, ensuring alignment with business objectives and the broader sourcing strategy.

- Stakeholder Support: Collaborate with key internal stakeholders to gather business requirements, providing insights and contributing to tailored sourcing strategies that deliver value across the McDonald’s global organization.

- Vendor & Supplier Coordination: Help manage relationships with key suppliers to ensure continuous improvement, identify innovative solutions, and support strategic partnerships.

- Category Plan Support: Assist the IT Software Sourcing team in the development and execution of strategic category plans, including cost savings, risk management, and process optimization for sub-categories.

- Negotiation Support: Contribute to the preparation of negotiations, ensuring the terms meet business requirements and support the execution of complex agreements and SLAs.

- Innovation Contribution: Support sourcing initiatives that drive cost savings, operational efficiency, and innovation in line with the company’s broader business strategies.

- Risk & Compliance Monitoring: Assist in ensuring sourcing strategies and supplier relationships align with McDonald’s compliance and risk management frameworks.

- Continuous Improvement: Contribute to continuous improvement efforts, providing input on sourcing processes, performance metrics, and benchmarks to improve sourcing outcomes.

- Team Collaboration: Work closely with team members to ensure smooth coordination on various sourcing projects and help facilitate the development of team capabilities.

Performance Motivation: Coach and mentor, the IT Software Sourcing category team to build skills and capabilities for personal and organizational growth

Qualifications

- Minimum 4-year bachelor’s degree required; MBA preferred.

- 5+ years of relevant experience in a highly complex environment and Global landscape with deep understanding of enterprise licensing (e.g., subscription/SaaS, audits), cloud pricing constructs, TCO and support models.

- Strong cross-functional leadership with IT, Security, Finance and Legal; proven negotiations delivering cost, risk and service outcomes.

- Strong background in procurement, strategic sourcing, and vendor relationship management, with excellent negotiation, communication, and problem-solving skills

Department Overview

The Manager, Global Legal & Compliance at Ronald McDonald House Global supports enterprise‑wide compliance, risk management, policy governance, and This role also supports contracting activities, including vendor agreements within a contract lifecycle management system.  Reporting to the General Counsel, Ronald McDonald House Global and working closely with functional leaders, the role ensures compliance, contracting, and risk management activities are identified, documented, and managed consistently, with strong visibility and alignment to the Ronald McDonald House Global’s broader risk management framework.

Key responsibilities include facilitating compliance awareness; supporting the development, implementation, and periodic review of policies and procedures; maintaining compliance documentation and mitigation activities; and advising the General Counsel on policy updates, training needs, and emerging risks. The role also supports insurance coordination, vendor procurement, and contract lifecycle management, including drafting, reviewing, and negotiating a broad range of legal agreements, and maintaining agreement templates and contracting resources.  The role also helps maintain the enterprise risk register.

Duties

Compliance and Risk

- Facilitate enterprise‑level awareness of compliance and risk across Ronald McDonald House Global.

- Support functional owners in identifying, documenting, and managing compliance risks.

- Create, implement, and ensure proper documentation of policies and procedures in coordination with Senior Leadership and business functional leads.

- Establish and document current and future mitigation activities.

- Proffer recommendations to the Ronald McDonald House Global’s General Counsel on revision of policies, training needs and other factors that affect compliance and areas of risk.

- Maintain awareness of incident responses, remediation, and corrective actions to ensure summary reporting is available for compliance requirements.

Vendor Procurement & Contract Lifecycle Management

- Lead and maintain Ronald McDonald House Global’s vendor procurement & management policies, standards, and core processes.

- Manage the vendor sourcing and engagement process, including maintenance of vendor service agreements, contract development, and coordination with vendor relationship managers.

- Draft, review, and negotiate a broad range of legal agreements with limited supervision for Ronald McDonald’s House Global, including vendor services agreements and other agreements managed both within and outside the contract lifecycle management system.

- In collaboration with the General Counsel, maintain and update legal agreement templates and related contracting resources as appropriate.

- Provide tools, resources, and guidance to Ronald McDonald House Global staff that enable adherence to and fulfillment of contract terms, renewal obligations, and related compliance requirements.

- Ensure vendors receive and acknowledge receipt of applicable policies, including the Vendor Code of Conduct, as part of their compliance obligations.

Ronald McDonald House Insurance Coverage Portfolio

- Act as a liaison between the Insurance Department, Ronald McDonald House Global Team members, and the Audit and Risk Committee to facilitate appropriate insurance coverage and ensure timely and accurate insurance filings.

Policies and Procedures

- Lead the dissemination, certification, and periodic review of the Ronald McDonald House Global Information Governance policies, procedures, and standards, including version control and logging.

- Coordinate with functional owners and support development, dissemination, certification, and periodic review of Ronald McDonald House Global policies, related procedures, and standards as appropriate, including version control and logging.

Enterprise Risk Management

- Maintain and periodically review Ronald McDonald House Global Risk Register, including documented risks, mitigation activities and their associated risk rankings.

- Document newly identified risks arising from incidents and/or other factors affecting Ronald McDonald House Global operations.

Qualifications

- Bachelor’s Degree in business administration, legal studies, finance or another related field.

- Certified Compliance & Ethics Professional (CCEP) or similar credentials preferred.

- Three to five years of experience in compliance, legal, risk management, corporate governance, or a related function; nonprofit experience preferred.

- Experience supporting enterprise‑level compliance, risk, or governance policies.

- Familiarity with vendor agreements, contract lifecycle management, and third‑party risk considerations.

- Experience supporting enterprise risk management activities, including risk identification, documentation, and mitigation tracking.

- Strong project management skills with the ability to coordinate cross‑functional work and manage multiple priorities.

- Demonstrated ability to design governance frameworks and processes executed by functional owners.

- Strong communication and influencing skills, with the ability to partner effectively across Finance, Technology, Legal, and Operations.

- High attention to detail with strong documentation and organizational skills.

- Demonstrate integrity, professionalism, discretion, and a strong commitment to ethical business practices.

- Proficiency in Microsoft Office 365 and DocuSign®; ability to quickly learn and adopt new systems and tools.

Long - Term Incentive: Yes

Benefits Eligible: Yes

Salary Range

The expected salary range for this role is $107,684.00 - $134,605.00 per year
